8002.notes: This seems to be the preferred reading. See CDB note 284.

examples.text: tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya. yañ'hi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhibhavanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhibhavanenā'ti

8006.meaning1: having conquered; having overpowered; having forced into submission

examples.text: so satthārā dinnanaye ṭhatvā satthāraṃ vanditvā, ajja ādiṃ katvā mama santakaṃ dasikasuttamattam'pi maṃ abhibhavitvā anekasatā'pi rājāno vā corā vā gaṇhituṃ samatthā nāma mā hontu, agginā'pi mama santakaṃ mā ḍayhatu, udakena'pi mā vuyhatū'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.

8008.meaning1: dimension of mastery; field of mastery; base for transcending; master of the domain
8008.commentary: (MNa) abhibh'āyatanakathāyaṃ abhibh'āyatanānī'ti abhibhavanakāraṇāni. kiṃ abhibhavanti? paccanīkadhamme'pi ārammaṇāni'pi. tāni hi paṭipakkhabhāvena paccanīkadhamme abhibhavanti, puggalassa ñāṇuttaritāya ārammaṇāni.
8008.notes: (NCPED) one of six or eight stages in overcoming reactions to objects of the senses

examples.text: aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, abhibh'āyatanāni. katamāni aṭṭha? ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī'ti, evaṃsaññī hoti. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ abhibh'āyatanaṃ.
veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhibhūtam'etaṃ āyatanaṃ. abhibh'āyatanañ'h'etaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā'ti

8010.meaning1: overlordship; fact of being the supreme being

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… ābhassarānaṃ ābhassarattena ananubhūtaṃ, subhakiṇhānaṃ subhakiṇhattena ananubhūtaṃ, vehapphalānaṃ vehapphalatte ananubhūtaṃ, abhibhussa abhibhuttena ananubhūtaṃ, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ.
yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.
bhagavā hi kāme abhibhuyya iriyati, ādicco'va pathaviṃ tejī tejasā, parittapaññassa me bhūripañña, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.

8012.commentary: (SNPa) pasayhacārī abhibhuyyacārī'ti tattha pasayha niggahetvā caraṇena pasayhacārī, abhibhavitvā, santāsetvā, vasīkatvā, caraṇena abhibhuyyacārī. sv'āyaṃ kāyabalena pasayhacārī, tejasā abhibhuyyacārī.

examples.text: yo kāme hitvā abhibhuyyacārī, yo vedi jātīmaraṇassa antaṃ, parinibbuto udakarahado'va sīto, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.
hitvā ratiñ'ca aratiñ'ca, sītibhūtaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, sabbaloka-abhibhuṃ vīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto, sakkhidhammam'anītiham'adassī, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassam'anusikkhe'ti.

8015.meaning2: overlord; name of a heavenly realm

examples.text: abhibhuṃ abhibhūto sañjānāti, abhibhuṃ abhibhūto saññatvā abhibhuṃ maññati, abhibhusmiṃ maññati, abhibhūto maññati, abhibhuṃ me'ti maññati, abhibhuṃ abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
eso hi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu'daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco yena dukkhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati
kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodha-abhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu odātavatthavasano, atha kho so dubbaṇṇo'va hoti kodha-abhibhūto.
katamena ekena balena? issariyabalena abhibhūtaṃ mātugāmaṃ n'eva rūpabalaṃ tāya'ti, na bhogabalaṃ tāya'ti, na ñātibalaṃ tāya'ti, na puttabalaṃ tāya'ti, na sīlabalaṃ tāyatī'ti.

8019.meaning1: names of Sikhī Buddha's pair of chief disciples; Abhibhū and Sambhava
8019.commentary: (SNa) abhibhūsambhavan'ti abhibhū ca sambhavo ca. tesu abhibhūthero sāriputtatthero viya paññāya aggo, sambhavatthero mahāmoggallāno viya samādhinā aggo.

examples.text: sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhūsambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.

8020.meaning1: I am the conqueror; I am the victor
8020.commentary: (ANa) sabbe made abhibho'smī'ti sabbe ime tayo'pi made adhibhaviṃ, atikkamma ṭhito'smī'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe made abhibho'smi, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, tassa me ahu ussāho, nibbānaṃ abhipassato.
so'haṃ evaṃ viharanto, ñatvā dhammaṃ nirūpadhiṃ. ārogye yobbanasmiñ'ca, jīvitasmiñ'ca ye madā. sabbe made abhibho'smi, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato.

8023.meaning2: focuses; fixes the mind; estimates oneself

examples.text: attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attajaṃ attasambhavaṃ, abhimatthati dummedhaṃ, vajiraṃ'v'asmamayaṃ maṇiṃ.
bālā kumudanāḷehi, pabbataṃ abhimatthatha, giriṃ nakhena khanatha, ayo dantehi khādatha.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya abhimatthanto aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā'ti?
yo'pi vassasataṃ jīve, so'pi maccuparāyaṇo, na kiñci parivajjeti, sabbam'eva-abhimaddatī'ti.
sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno abhiharati abhimaddati anupajagghati khalitaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.

8034.meaning1: directed towards; aimed at; focused on; intent on

examples.text: arūpa dūraṅ'gama ekacāri, na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni'haṃ, dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānam'eva-abhimano carissaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani abhimantheyya, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimattā vātā muddhani ūhananti.

8039.meaning1: (of a fire stick) rubs hard; creates friction; drills

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso aggi'tthiko aggigavesī aggipariyesanaṃ caramāno allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya abhimantheyya.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, aggivessana, api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ, udake nikkhittaṃ, uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā'ti?

8041.meaning1: would violently crush; would forcefully press

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani abhimantheyya, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimattā vātā muddhani ūhananti.

8045.meaning2: facing, present, face to face with

examples.text: pāṭaligāmikā'pi kho upāsakā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasath'āgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchima-abhimukhā nisīdiṃsu, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva purakkhatvā.

upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthā-abhimukho nisīdi. bhikkhusaṅgho'pi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthā-abhimukho nisīdi, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva purakkhatvā.
app'ossukko tvaṃ, mahārāja, vīthiyo sodhāpetvā… saparijano uposathaṃ samādiyitvā… sāyanhasamaye mahānāgavan'uyyāna-abhimukho yāhi addhā tasmiṃ ṭhāne dhātuyo lacchasī'ti

8047.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of abhimukha
8047.meaning1: towards; facing; in the direction of

examples.text: gahapatiko rathā otaritvā kesesu gahetvā nāmetvā kapparapahārehi koṭṭetvā gale gahetvā āgatamagga-abhimukhaṃ khipitvā pakkāmi
okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.
tatiyam'pi kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānam'indo suvīraṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi, ete, tāta suvīra, asurā deve abhiyanti. gaccha, tāta suvīra, asure paccuyyāhī'ti.

8057.meaning1: wanting to invade; wishing to attack; desiring to march against
8057.meaning2: wanting to invade; wishing to attack; desiring to march against

examples.text: evañ'ca vadehi, rājā, bhante, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātu'kāmo. so evam'āha, ahaṃ h'ime vajjī evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve ucchecchāmi vajjī, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmī'ti.

8058.meaning1: to invade; to attack; to march against
8058.meaning2: to invade; to attack; to march against

examples.text: evañ'ca vadehi, rājā, bhante, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātu'kāmo. so evam'āha, ahaṃ h'ime vajjī evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve ucchecchāmi vajjī, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmī'ti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, asurā deve abhiyaṃsu. atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānam'indo suvīraṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi, ete, tāta suvīra, asurā deve abhiyanti.

8062.meaning1: lays a charge; litigates; initiates legal proceedings

8071.meaning1: who observes; who practises; who is expert (in); (comm) engaged in the art of auspicious signs

examples.text: abhiyogino ca nipuṇā, bahū pana nimittakovidā, sukhumanayanakusalā manujā, piyadassano'ti abhiniddisanti naṃ.

8072.commentary: (THIa) su abhiyobbanaṃ patī'ti sundare abhinavayobbanakāle sā nāsikā idāni jarāya nivāritasobhatāya pariseditā viya varattā viya ca jātā.

examples.text: saṇhatuṅgasadisī ca nāsikā, sobhate su abhiyobbanaṃ pati, sā jarāya upakūlitā viya, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

8077.meaning1: really enjoying; very fond (of); taking extreme pleasure (in); indulging (in)

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiratā jarāsaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiratā maraṇasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiratā… jātisaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharonti
ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu sakkāya-abhirato nappajahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, addhā ime āyasmanto tassa bhagavato sāsane uḷāraṃ pubben'āparaṃ visesaṃ jānanti, tathā hi ime āyasmanto haṭṭhapahaṭṭhā udagg'udaggā abhiratarūpā pīṇ'indriyā app'ossukkā pannalomā paradattavuttā migabhūtena cetasā viharantī'ti.

8079.synonym: attamanatā, abhinandi, nandi, nandī, pīti, ratī, vitta, vitti

examples.text: tatra-abhiratim'iccheyya, hitvā kāme akiñcano, pariyodapeyya attānaṃ, cittaklesehi paṇḍito.
taṃ kut'ettha labbhā yaṃ me paro anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyya

8080.meaning1: completely infatuated; obsessed; smitten; enamoured; fixated (with)

examples.text: aññaṃ ito y'ābhivadanti dhammaṃ, aparaddhā suddhim'akevalī te, evam'pi titthyā puthuso vadanti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te-abhirattā.

8081.meaning2: state of infatuation; state of being extremely enamoured

8082.synonym: attamana, āraddha, āraddhacitta, tappita, patīta, patītarūpa, pamudita, pamodita, vitta, santappita, santusita, sammudita, sukhita

examples.text: purimen'ev'āhaṃ, bhante, opammena bhagavato attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ
atha kho bhagavā bhoganagare yathā-abhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pāvā ten'upasaṅkamissāmā'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathā-abhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. katame aṭṭha?
ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya… gām'ante abhiramāpanāya manussakantesu sīlesu samādapanāya.

8093.meaning1: to cause (someone) to delight (in); to make (someone) take pleasure (in)

examples.text: ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itih'ītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ abhiramiṃ.

8097.meaning1: to enjoy; to delight; to take pleasure (in)

8099.commentary: (MNa) rāj'ābhirājā'ti rājūnaṃ pūjanīyo, adhirājā hutvā, cakkavattī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: khattiyā bhogirājāno, anuyantā bhavantu te, rāja-abhirājā manuj'indo, rajjaṃ kārehi gotama.
